title: Scripted-clock retry helpers should await the retry acknowledgement before advancing the clock, and the budget-clock fence test should assert the retry_acknowledgement flag
outcome: The scripted-clock retry helpers (retry_when_due in engram_closing_checkpoint_retry.rs and engram_closing_checkpoint_retry_transient.rs, replay_when_due in engram_root_begin_unsent.rs) wait on the retry record's acknowledgement fence BEFORE advancing the scripted clock past a bind backoff. They assert that the wait returned Some(Ok(())), so a backoff of 20 s or more can never expire the fence silently. The budget-clock fence test also asserts that the fence reaching the writer carries retry_acknowledgement and an EngramAdmission target.
acceptance: The three helpers await the acknowledgement fence before any clock advance, and assert matches!(wait, Some(Ok(()))), as engram_root_recovery_live.rs does.
a_retry_record_acknowledgement_fence_expires_on_the_budget_clock receives the writer's request and asserts it is a Fence with retry_acknowledgement == true and an EngramAdmission target.
The affected tests pass on a host-recorded focused run.
